map.凯撒密码（Caesar cipher）是一种最简单且最广为人知的加密技术，属于替: Apply the Caesar shift cipher to text in your browser — a classic substitution cipher for learning and quick obfuscation.
map.💡 暴力破解会尝试所有 25 种移位，点击任意结果可使用该移位。: 💡 Brute force tries all 25 shifts; click any result to apply that shift.
map.解密是加密的逆过程，将字母向前移动 k 位即可还原。: Decryption is the inverse of encryption: shift each letter back by k to recover the original.
map.凯撒密码以古罗马军事家尤利乌斯·凯撒命名，他在高卢战争中使用这种密码与远方的将领: The Caesar cipher is named after the Roman general Julius Caesar, who used it during the Gallic Wars to communicate with distant commanders. Most people were illiterate at the time, so this simple shift was secret enough.
map.凯撒密码非常容易被破解，因为只有 25 种可能的移位。暴力破解只需尝试所有 25: The Caesar cipher is trivially broken because there are only 25 possible shifts — brute force simply tries all 25. It is intended for learning the basics of cryptography and must not be used for real security.

map.古典密码教学、简单字母位移加密演示（位移 3 为标准 Caesar）。: Teaching classical cryptography and demonstrating simple letter-shift encryption (a shift of 3 is the standard Caesar cipher).
map.暴力破解演示：移位只有 25 种可能，把 25 种结果全部列出，肉眼即可挑出有意: Brute-force demonstration: with only 25 possible shifts, listing all 25 results lets the eye pick out the meaningful plaintext — the most intuitive way to explain that key space determines security.
map.输入 `HELLO`，key=3 → 输出 `KHOOR`（每位后移 3：H→K: Input `HELLO` with key=3 → output `KHOOR` (each letter shifted forward by 3: H→K, E→H, …).
map.不安全，仅 25 种密钥，暴力枚举即可破解，仅作教学。: No. With only 25 keys it falls to brute-force enumeration, so it is for teaching only.
map.ROT13 和凯撒密码是什么关系？: How does ROT13 relate to the Caesar cipher?
map.ROT13 就是位移量固定为 13 的凯撒密码。因为英文字母有 26 个，加密两: ROT13 is simply the Caesar cipher with a fixed shift of 13. Because the Latin alphabet has 26 letters, encrypting twice returns the original, so — like Atbash — it is self-inverse. That is why early online forums used it to hide spoilers (one more click reveals the text), yet it provides no confidentiality at all.
